objective: Test whether a fixed causal cooldown based only on already resolved prior strategy trades reduces clustered bad losses without adding price-pattern filters.

common_parent_logic.desired_state: At each closed H4 decision, LONG when source_close > broker_day_open and SHORT when source_close < broker_day_open.
common_parent_logic.entry: Exact M1 open at the desired-state flip; no fallback.
common_parent_logic.initial_stop: 4.00 times decision-time closed M15 Wilder ATR14.
common_parent_logic.profit_lock: After favorable excursion reaches 2.00 entry ATR, from the next existing M1 move stop to +0.25 ATR for LONG or -0.25 ATR for SHORT.
common_parent_logic.exit: Active stop or next desired-state flip.
common_parent_logic.after_stop_without_cooldown: Remain flat until next desired-state flip.
common_parent_logic.same_m1_sequence: At a state flip, close the old position at exact M1 open, finalize its net outcome, update cooldown state, then decide whether the new episode is allowed.

configurations.rule: After INITIAL_SL or INITIAL_SL_GAP_OPEN, skip exactly the next desired-state episode.
After any completed trade with net_pnl < 0, skip exactly the next desired-state episode.
After two consecutive completed trades each with net_pnl < 0, skip exactly the next desired-state episode and reset the consecutive-loss counter.
After INITIAL_SL or INITIAL_SL_GAP_OPEN, block new entries whose source broker day equals the normalized broker-server date of the stop exit; reconsider on a later broker day.
After INITIAL_SL or INITIAL_SL_GAP_OPEN, skip exactly the next two desired-state episodes.

matched_skip_selectivity.definition: Map each skipped episode to the frozen control episode at the same event and compare skipped control loss-dollar share with sacrificed control profit-dollar share.
